purpose: Generate a set of child-friendly educational images for a woodwork vocabulary trainer (age 11, 5th grade).

output.style: Clean, simple educational photo/illustration on a plain light background; single subject centered; soft even lighting; no text, no watermark, no logos; square 1:1. For diagram terms (dimensions and views), a simple labeled line drawing is fine.
